name: com.unity.networking.backgrounddownload
description:
Extended version of the original package with additional features by JG.

Enable file downloads in background for mobile platforms.
Allows to launch file downloads that will continue even if the app goes into background or gets quit by the operating system. The downloads can be picked the next time the app is started.

Additional features:
- Android implementation using OkHttp for improved download stability and performance
- Editor support for downloading files (play mode / development testing)

Supported platforms:
- Android
- iOS
- UWP
